checks.name: Every row has a Number
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE Number IS NULL

checks.name: No Number appears twice
checks.sql: SELECT Number, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM incident GROUP BY Number HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

checks.name: At most 5 P1 incidents
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE Priority = 'P1 - Critical'

checks.name: No assignment group has more than 40 open tickets
checks.sql: SELECT "Assignment group", COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM incident WHERE State NOT IN ('Closed', 'Resolved', 'Canceled', 'Cancelled') GROUP BY "Assignment group" HAVING COUNT(*) > 40
